settings.label: World name
settings.description: The name players see for this server in their network settings.

settings.label: World slot
settings.description: Which saved world the server opens. Each slot from 0 to 29 is a world of its own; an empty slot makes a new world.

settings.label: Seed
settings.description: The seed a new world is generated from. 0 picks a random one. Only used when the world is first made.

settings.label: World mode
settings.description: How tough the monsters are in a new world. Changing it later does not change an existing world.

settings.label: Season
settings.description: The seasonal event in the world. By date follows the calendar.

settings.label: Maximum players
settings.description: How many players can be connected at once. More players need more memory.

settings.label: Game ID
settings.description: What Steam players type to join. Empty makes a new one each start. A fixed one is 28 letters and numbers, without Y, y, x, 0 or O.

settings.label: Direct-connect password
settings.description: The password for joining by IP and port. Empty makes a new one each start. Joining by Game ID needs no password.

settings.label: Send rate
settings.description: How many times a second the server sends updates to players.

settings.label: Packets per frame
settings.description: The most packets sent to a player in one frame.
